# Sweepr Legal Documents

> Official legal documents for Sweepr (operated by ClearKey Solutions, LLC),
> a home-cleaning marketplace connecting customers with background-checked
> independent cleaners in the United States.

- [Terms of Service](https://legal.getsweepr.com/terms): Terms of Service.
- [Privacy Policy](https://legal.getsweepr.com/privacy): Privacy Policy.
- [End User License Agreement](https://legal.getsweepr.com/eula): End User License Agreement.
- [Dispute Resolution](https://legal.getsweepr.com/dispute-resolution): Dispute Resolution.
- [Accessibility Statement](https://legal.getsweepr.com/accessibility): Accessibility Statement.
- [Electronic Communications & E-Sign Consent](https://legal.getsweepr.com/e-sign): Electronic Communications & E-Sign Consent.
